title: Resolve a Merge Conflict
description: Merge the feature branch into master, resolve the conflicting change in README.md, and leave the repository in a clean completed state.

tasks.label: Complete the merge and leave the repository clean

hints: The feature and master branches changed the same line in README.md. Begin by bringing the feature branch into the branch that should receive the work.
Git will mark the conflicting part of README.md so you can decide which final content should remain. Resolve that section and make sure the conflict markers are gone.
After resolving the file, tell Git that the conflict is resolved and finish the merge. Before checking the solution, make sure the repository has no unfinished merge state or pending changes.

intro.message: The feature is ready, but both branches changed the same line. We need to bring the feature into master and resolve the conflict without leaving the repository half-merged.

startMerge.message: There it is — Git found the conflicting change. Now we need to decide what the final README should say.

resolveConflict.message: Nice. The conflicting section is resolved. Make sure Git sees the file as resolved before finishing the merge.

completeMerge.message: Perfect. The merge is complete and the repository is back to a clean state.

success.message: Nice work! You handled the conflict, preserved both branches' history, and completed the merge cleanly.

failure.message: The merge isn't in a completed state yet. Check the conflict resolution, merge history, and working tree before trying again.
